security.title: Two-factor authentication (TOTP)
security.loginHint: Complete sign-in with your authenticator or a recovery code.
security.reauthHint: Enter a new code from your authenticator. Verification lasts 10 minutes.
security.failed: Verification failed. Check your password or code and try again.
security.unlockHint: Enter a code from your authenticator to continue.
security.qrError: QR unavailable. Enter the setup key manually.
security.enabled: Enabled. New sign-ins require your authenticator.
security.disabled: Disabled. Enable it to protect new sign-ins.
security.recoveryHint: Save these 10 recovery codes in a safe place. Each works once. They will not be shown again.
security.disabledNotice: Two-factor authentication disabled. Other devices have been signed out.
security.passwordNotice: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
security.increaseHint: Increasing the hours requires recent authenticator verification.
security.disableHint: Turning this off requires recent authenticator verification.
security.validUntil: Valid until {{time}}. Scan it, then enter a code.
security.lockDescription_one: Automatically lock after {{count}} hour without web activity
security.lockDescription_other: Automatically lock after {{count}} hours without web activity
security.attemptsRevoked: This session ended after 5 incorrect authenticator codes. Sign in again.
security.stepUpHint: Enter your account password and a new code from your authenticator. A recovery code is not accepted here.
security.reauthExpired: Verification expired. Try again and enter an authenticator code when asked.
security.codeRejected: Incorrect or already used code. Wait for a new code. Attempts remaining: {{count}}.
security.codeRejectedNoCount: Incorrect or already used code. Wait for a new code and try again.
